notes: Three of the four Contradicted claims are in non-other areas, so they drive the verdict. (1) crypto: the app trusts a test K3 public key whose private key is committed (tools/sign_bundle_manifest.py:25). (2) privacy: the S5 exported allow-list gained ProfileInstallReceiver without a doc update, which is probably a doc typo. (3) other: Play upload can 'succeed' in simulated mode. Other drift: Appendix A and docs/ci-templates are stale relative to .github/workflows, and repo-ci.yml is undocumented. Partial findings: the backup-age self-test is ineffective; NG-055 has only a fake update manager; v1.0.0 release notes are missing. backend/deploy matches Appendix C and D byte for byte. trace.py --tests shows TC-OPS-01..03, 05, 06, 08..11, TC-SEC-10..14 and TC-API-30 at 0 tests. Whether a build with triage on can ship is left to the triage audit. The inventory JSON records commit 4f04aef while the prompt names 4523908.
